statusText: Mapped policy state: EA_ON. Tail remains low while today's U.S. macro releases and Nvidia keep Stress elevated.
recommendation: Tail remains below the block threshold. The principal checkpoints are the 12:30 UTC U.S. data cluster, the cash-open response, and Nvidia's 21:00 UTC results webcast.
headline: Low Tail, elevated event Stress ahead of U.S. data and Nvidia
body: Current reporting shows Nasdaq-100 futures only slightly softer, oil lower and the U.S. 10-year yield easing. No persistent one-way NQ path is independently verified. Today's macro cluster and Nvidia can raise volatility, but Tail remains tied to observed mean-reversion failure rather than event importance alone.

forecast.analysis: The Europe-open handoff can test overnight softness. Tail stays low unless NQ begins holding an extreme with shallow pullbacks while rates, semiconductors and breadth align directionally.
European participation may widen the range. Mixed cross-asset confirmation would keep Tail contained; repeated NQ extension after weak retracements would be the key escalation signal.
European cash trading increases positioning sensitivity ahead of U.S. data. Tail remains conditional on directional efficiency and aligned cross-assets rather than on the calendar itself.
Pre-U.S. positioning becomes more catalyst-sensitive as the 12:30 UTC data cluster approaches. Stress rises, while Tail still requires observed persistence or failed retracements.
The final pre-release hour concentrates event uncertainty. A clean two-sided range keeps Tail low; pre-data one-way NQ structure with shallow pullbacks would raise the path risk.
GDP, Personal Income and Outlays, and durable goods are scheduled at 12:30 UTC. WATCH reflects conditional post-release path risk, not an assumed surprise or market reaction.
Post-data repricing overlaps the U.S. pre-open. Meaningful retracements and cross-asset stabilization would favor rapid Tail normalization; repeated extension would sustain WATCH.
The U.S. cash open tests whether any data move persists. Tail remains WATCH only if opening-auction continuation, shallow pullbacks and aligned rates/semis confirm directional efficiency.
After the opening window, two-sided price discovery would pull Tail back below WATCH. A failure to retrace an established move would instead keep path risk elevated.
Mid-morning liquidity can reveal whether the opening move is durable or exhausted. Tail stays low if retracements deepen and cross-assets stop reinforcing one direction.
With the main macro/opening window past, Stress can ease if price discovery is orderly. Persistent extension without meaningful retracement would invalidate that normalization.
Afternoon conditions are comparatively calmer, but positioning ahead of Nvidia can keep index sensitivity elevated. Tail remains tied to observed price-path persistence.
drivers: Nvidia catalyst later in the session

forecast.analysis: Pre-Nvidia positioning may lift volatility into the after-hours catalyst. The scheduled event raises Stress; Tail stays below WATCH unless one-way structure is already established.
Nvidia's 21:00 UTC results webcast is a major index catalyst. WATCH is conditional on the possibility of concentrated repricing; no result, guidance or market reaction is assumed.
The immediate post-Nvidia window carries the day's highest conditional Stress. Tail reaches the top of WATCH only if the released information produces persistent, weakly retracing NQ direction.
Early post-event digestion can remain volatile. Meaningful retracements or conflicting megacap/semiconductor response would reduce Tail; repeated extension would keep WATCH active.
Later after-hours trading should clarify whether the initial Nvidia response persists. Tail normalizes if price becomes two-sided; a continuing extreme-hold path would delay normalization.
Overnight Asia handoff may absorb residual Nvidia repricing. Stress remains elevated, while Tail depends on whether directional extension continues without meaningful retracement.
As Asian liquidity deepens, a broader two-sided range would further reduce Tail. Continued semiconductor-led extension with weak pullbacks would keep risk above baseline.
Late-Asia conditions are expected to be calmer absent new shocks. Tail remains low unless the prior event move continues with unusually persistent directional efficiency.
The next Europe handoff can retest any overnight trend. Cross-asset conflict would support normalization; aligned rates, semiconductors and NQ extremes would be the main escalation path.
Early European liquidity should provide another retracement test. Tail stays low if the market rotates rather than extends in one direction.
By the end of the 24-hour horizon, event Stress should be lower if Nvidia repricing has stabilized. Tail remains conditional on observed persistence, not on the prior event's importance alone.
